name: Spaceship 56ddb3e7 on the 2-uniform tiling k2-012
description: A period-6 spaceship on the 2-uniform tiling k2-012 (touching neighbours), 7 cells, moving one lattice step every 6 generations (c/6). It runs the same way in the 262,144 rules from B45/S34 to B4,5,8,9,10,11,12,13,14/S0,1,3,4,6,7,8,9,10,11,12,13,14; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 110 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
